title: North — Program (schema v0, revised by decision record 0002)
description: Document for one master's program (BR-01). Version 0: draft for the manual pilot (Phase 4), revised to match UML model 1.0 and decision record 0002 (docs/decisions/0002-after-data-spikes.md). Fields inside each dimension will be revised with pilot data (schema v1). Every verifiable field is a VerifiedValue (BR-02, NFR-01, 0002/A1).
$comment: Mapping to the ER (UML §8): schema_version, id, name, degree and the dimensions (immigration, academic, cost, funding, admissions, career, family) become columns of `programs`; `campus` becomes `campuses` (+ `localities`) and `programs.campus_id`; `institution` becomes `institutions` + `institution_identifiers`; `classifications` becomes `program_classifications` (code = `verified` jsonb, 0002/A7); `eligibilities` is derived (`program_eligibilities`) and only appears in the document for export and for the pilot. `in_strategy` and `flags` are derived (0002/A11, R1) and are never filled by hand.

id.description: Stable program slug (institution + degree + field + campus).

is_fictitious.description: true for examples and test fixtures. A record with true must never be published or imported into production.

kind.description: Record 0008/T13: a degree program or a language course. Absent means degree. A language course carries `language_course` and needs no classification (it has no CIP or ISCED-F field).

intl_authorization.description: Record 0008/T5: authorization held by the program itself (Irish lists: scheme ie_ilep or ie_trusted, confirmed_official from the uploaded list). The US keeps SEVP on campus.intl_authorization. Absence from a list is unknown, never confirmed_negative automatically (BR-18).

identifiers.description: Record 0008/T6: identifiers of the program in official lists (program_identifiers), e.g. ie_ilep_ref 0018/0001, ie_trusted_ref TE0058/0012. One value names one program.

campus.description: Each program belongs to exactly one campus (R17).

classifications.description: Program classifications. Exactly one primary, in the country's scheme (US: cip2020). ISCED-F comes from ClassificationMap and need not be filled in here.

eligibilities.description: Derived (BR-03): classification checked against the current rule version. In the manual pilot the curator fills it in by looking up the official list.

in_strategy.description: Derived (0002/A11): false when `modality` is online or `immigration.f1_compatible_modality` is confirmed_negative (BR-14). Computed by the system; not filled in by hand and not a column of the pilot spreadsheet.

flags.description: Derived flags. `no_stem_opt_extension` (R1): the primary CIP is 52.12xx, which is not on the DHS STEM list; the program stays in scope, the card says so and post_study_work uses the 12-month OPT only. Computed by the system.

immigration.description: Immigration fields from the country module. The concrete schema is selected by `country` (see the allOf at the end of this schema).

allOf.$comment: Per-country routing. To add a country (e.g. CA): 1) create $defs.immigration_ca; 2) add a block here {if country = CA, then immigration -> immigration_ca}; 3) add "CA" to the list in the generic block below. Nothing else in the schema changes.
Country without a module yet: accepts any snake_case key as long as each value is a VerifiedValue. Lets data be recorded before the module exists; the filter treats the program as undetermined.
Record 0008/T13: a language course carries its course facts and needs no classification; a degree needs exactly one primary classification and carries no course facts.

VerificationStatus.description: BR-02 (0002/A3): only confirmed_negative fails the filter by itself; comparing a known value against the profile can also fail. R12: for yes/no fields a confirmed "no" is always confirmed_negative (value false), never confirmed_official/reported_by_program + false; numeric and text fields never use confirmed_negative.

SourceKind.description: R13. page = a web page (program, school, government); official_list = an official list or dataset (DHS STEM list, SEVP list, IPEDS, Scorecard, DAPIP, HUD); correspondence = a written reply (e.g. from the international office): source_url may be null, the message is stored privately and never in public fields; uploaded_file = an official file uploaded by the admin (FR-26, source_files).

VerifiedValue.description: Envelope for every verifiable field (UML: VerifiedValue<T>, 0002/A1). Each field narrows `value` with allOf. Rules: NFR-01 (source required when a value is asserted), 0002/A4 (confirmed_negative and extracted_unverified), R12 (polarity), R13 (source_kind), FR-13 (extraction carries a literal excerpt), BR-02 (unknown has no value).

evidence.description: Literal excerpt from the source that supports the value. Public field: never a name or an email address (R13, NFR-10); an email address is rejected by the schema.

allOf.$comment: NFR-01 / 0002/A4 / R13: every status that asserts something (or a confirmed no) needs a source_kind and a date.
NFR-01 / 0002/A4 / R13: ...and a source_url, except when the source is a written reply (correspondence), which may have no URL.
FR-13 / 0002/A4: an LLM-extracted value carries its source page and the literal excerpt.

R12: confirmed_negative is only for yes/no fields, and its value is the "no": `false`, or an Authorization with authorized = false. Any numeric, text or enum field therefore cannot use it (its value type excludes false).
R12: a confirmed "no" is never confirmed_official / reported_by_program + false. extracted_unverified + false is allowed (not confirmed); when the curator accepts it, it becomes confirmed_negative.
BR-02 / FR-13: unknown never carries a value.
Statuses that assert a value need a value.

Money.description: Monetary amount with currency (C-09f). Conversion happens only at evaluation time, with a dated FxRate.

MoneyRate.description: Money + billing basis. Without `per`, a tuition amount is ambiguous (per credit? per year?).

code.description: The code is verifiable (0002/A7): it comes from ingestion (confirmed_official, source_kind official_list or uploaded_file, US: IPEDS C<year>_A at 6-digit CIP) or from the program site (reported_by_program). BR-11 requires a verified CIP. In the database: program_classifications.verified.

rule_version.description: Version of the official list used (e.g. publication date of the DHS STEM list, 2024-07-22).

result.description: 0002/A8. true = eligible: confirmed_official only if the primary code is on the current rule version (BR-03, whole 2-digit series included through the rule params, 0002/A14). Primary code known and not on the list: false + confirmed_negative (R12). Code unknown but the program claims it: true + reported_by_program.

claim_mismatch.description: 0002/A8. true when the program claims eligibility (immigration.stem_opt_claimed_by_program = true) but the primary code disagrees with the rule. Derived; in the pilot the curator may fill it in.

CefrBand.description: CEFR band of a course's entry or exit level. A0 is pre-A1, as the Irish lists write it.

ExamCode.description: Exam a course prepares for, normalized from the list's awarding body through data/reference/ie_exam_names.csv (raw text kept in evidence).

LanguageCourse.description: Record 0008/T13: the facts of a language course. cefr_entry, cefr_exit, exam, weeks and hours_per_week come from the official lists (confirmed_official, uploaded_file); price and start_dates from the school's own site (FR-13). A value the list does not state plainly is unknown with the raw text in evidence.

start_dates.description: One VerifiedValue per start date; an empty list means none collected yet (shown as unknown).

scheme.description: 0002/A15: `dapip` is a valid scheme. SEVP codes are not institution identifiers: the campus code lives on the campus (campus.sevp_campus_code) and the school code is not unique (R5).

InstitutionRef.description: Institution data embedded in the program document, for the pilot and the dump. In the database it becomes the institutions and institution_identifiers tables.

accreditation.description: R10 / BR-04: institutional accreditation by a recognized accreditor (US: an agency recognized by the U.S. Department of Education, checked in DAPIP). "Regional" is not used. Treated as a yes/no field with details (R12): a confirmed absence of recognized institutional accreditation is value false + confirmed_negative; a positive value is an Accreditation object.

carnegie_classification.description: 0002/A12: Carnegie research classification of the institution (e.g. R1, R2). Used only in the quality criterion. Replaces academic.research_classification.

examples: Southern Association of Colleges and Schools Commission on Colleges

institutional.description: Only institutional accreditation counts for BR-04; programmatic accreditation (e.g. ABET) goes in academic.specialized_accreditation.

Locality.description: R17: the area that links a campus to the reference rent (US: HUD FMR by county, scheme us_county_fips). In the database: `localities`.

Campus.description: R17: the campus the program belongs to. In the database: `campuses` (institution_id, name, city, locality_id, sevp_campus_code, latitude, longitude, intl_authorization). SEVP certification lives here (R11).

sevp_campus_code.description: R5: SEVP campus code (15 characters, e.g. DAL214F00932000), stored once a match is confirmed; later SEVP imports match by it. The 12-character school code is not unique and is not stored as an identifier.

intl_authorization.description: Authorization to enroll foreign students (generic Authorization). US: scheme = sevp, authorized = F-1 flag of the SEVP list. A campus confirmed as not certified: confirmed_negative with authorized = false (R12).

immigration_us.description: Immigration fields of the `us` module (F-1). SEVP lives on the campus (campus.intl_authorization), the I-20 on the program (R11), and STEM in eligibilities (us.stem_opt).

i20_issued_for_program.description: The school issues an I-20 for this specific program (BR-04). R11: the international office (DSO), through its official page or a written reply (source_kind = correspondence), counts as confirmed_official; the department page alone is reported_by_program.

f1_compatible_modality.description: The delivery mode allows keeping F-1 status (distance-learning limits).

stem_opt_claimed_by_program.description: The program advertises itself as STEM. Confirms nothing by itself: used to flag a mismatch with the CIP (BR-03, eligibilities[].claim_mismatch, 0002/A8).

cpt_available.description: The curriculum allows CPT (work/internship during the program).

cpt_from_first_term.description: CPT allowed from the first term ("Day-1 CPT"). Feeds the immigration risk (BR-06).

immigration_generic.description: Placeholder for countries without a module: free keys, values always VerifiedValue.

duration_months.description: Typical full-time duration. Basis of the cost period (BR-07).

specialized_accreditation.description: Program-level accreditations (e.g. ABET). Empty list with an asserting status = none.

RentReference.description: Reference rent by number of bedrooms in the campus locality (US: HUD Fair Market Rent, monthly). In the database it is stored once per locality in `rent_benchmarks` (R17, one row per bedrooms count); here it is a copy for the pilot and the export. Bedrooms used for a profile = ceil((1 + dependents) / 2), max 4 (R6).

area.description: Name of the reference area (e.g. HUD metro area).

Cost.description: Inputs to the four BR-07 numbers. (1) tuition + fees: tuition_international + fees (or tuition_fees_program_total, if published). (2) visa financial requirement: i20_requirement_student + n × i20_requirement_per_dependent. (3) living cost: living_cost_student, adjusted for the family using rent_reference_monthly and the family fields. (4) period total net of funding: NOT stored here, because it depends on the profile (dependents) and on funding; it is computed at evaluation time (CostEstimate.period_total_net subtracts guaranteed funding only; CostEstimate.period_total_with_competitive_funding also subtracts competitive funding, R15).

tuition_international.description: Tuition for international students (in the US, the non-resident rate).

fees.description: Mandatory fees on top of tuition.

student_health_insurance.description: Mandatory student health insurance, if billed separately.

tuition_fees_program_total.description: BR-07 number 1 when the program publishes the total. If only a per-credit rate exists, the calculation uses tuition_international × credits_required.

i20_requirement_student.description: BR-07 number 2: amount the school requires the student alone to document.

i20_requirement_per_dependent.description: Additional amount required per dependent on the I-20.

living_cost_student.description: School's living-cost estimate for a single student.

availability.description: guaranteed = guaranteed with admission; competitive = contested but common; rare = exists but rarely for master's students.

Funding.description: Object, not a list: an empty list could not tell "no funding" from "nobody looked" (BR-02). available_to_masters answers that; opportunities gives the details.

available_to_masters.description: The program or department funds master's students in some form.

English.description: English requirement. R12: whether a test is accepted is a yes/no field (`<test>_accepted`); "test not accepted" = `<test>_accepted` false + confirmed_negative, and the `<test>_min` fields stay unknown. Minimums are numbers and never use confirmed_negative.

duolingo_accepted.description: The program accepts the Duolingo English Test.

waiver_available.description: A test waiver exists (e.g. degree taught in English).

conditional_admission.description: Conditional admission accepted (English later, e.g. via the school's English program).

Deadline.description: Value of one deadline item (R18: term, kind, date; term_year and applicant narrow it).

accepts_other_undergrad_area.description: Accepts an undergraduate degree in another field (BR-04).

prerequisites.description: Courses or knowledge required from applicants coming from another field.

gmat.description: Record 0005: GMAT requirement, same scale as gre (common in analytics and information systems programs).

application_fee_waiver.description: Record 0005: the program or graduate school offers an application fee waiver to international applicants (yes/no; a confirmed 'no' is confirmed_negative, R12). Conditions go in evidence.

deadlines.description: R18: a list where each item is its own VerifiedValue (deadlines often come from different pages: graduate school vs department). An empty list means no deadline was recorded (it never means "no deadlines"). Items are never unknown: a deadline you did not find is simply not in the list.

population.description: Population covered by the measure. Scorecard = federal_aid_recipients, which excludes international students (BR-13).

median_earnings.description: Median earnings of program graduates (field + master's level).

placement_rate_pct.description: Placement rate published by the program. The window (e.g. 6 months) goes in evidence.

dependent_insurance_available.description: The school health plan covers spouse and children.

dependent_insurance_cost.description: Plan cost for spouse + children (the plan's "family" tier).

spouse_support_programs.description: Programs for spouses of international students (English classes, family groups).

k12_district.description: Public school district for the campus.
